recording_disclaimer.description: Agent tells the customer the call is being recorded
required_elements: States the call will be recorded for quality assurance and training

plan_price_intro.description: The monthly price the agent quotes for the PROMOTIONAL / introductory period (the discounted price for the first months). Not the regular price that applies afterwards, not the price the customer pays their current provider, and not an upfront or total cost.

plan_price_standard.description: The monthly price the agent quotes for AFTER the promotion ends (the regular / standard price). Not the discounted introductory price, and not the price the customer pays their current provider.

email_match.description: The customer's email address as the agent reads it out or the customer confirms it. Copy it exactly as spoken, including any spelling mistakes.

service_address_match.description: The address where the internet service will be CONNECTED (the connection / service address), as the agent reads it back or the customer confirms it. NOT the modem delivery address: if the customer talks about a different address for delivery, ignore that for this check.

delivery_address_match.description: The address the MODEM will be delivered to. If the customer accepted delivery to the connection address, that address; if they gave a different delivery address, the different one. Not the connection address when a separate delivery address was given.

modem_free.description: What the agent says the customer pays UPFRONT for the modem itself (the modem's upfront cost). Not the monthly plan price, not a delivery charge, and not the total minimum cost.

dead_air.description: No long silences during the call

interruptions.description: Agent does not talk over the customer
